title: Bigger Headline Same Poster
tests: Tests whether enlarging text reuses the existing illustration and changes only the text overlay, without regenerating or paying for the artwork again.

exact_text.read_as: Reuse the exact headline words from the original text-overlay operation for slow_sunday_poster.png

faults.what: The requested headline is missing; large white instructional text and a filename appear instead.
An enormous grey overlay covers most of the cream background and obscures the coffee cup.
The replacement text occupies most of the poster, clips at the horizontal edges, and is not the requested dark brown headline near the top.

judge.summary: The square poster is unusable because oversized white instructions replace the headline and a grey overlay obscures the cream background and cup.

must_haves.item: The headline reads exactly 'SLOW SUNDAY', with no other words.
must_haves.why: The headline is absent and numerous unwanted instructional words appear.

must_haves.item: The headline is approximately 1.5 times its original font size and remains fully inside the canvas.
must_haves.why: There is no requested headline to enlarge, and the replacement text extends beyond the canvas edges.

must_haves.item: The headline retains its original font, dark brown colour and centre point.
must_haves.why: The visible text is white and spread across the central area rather than a dark brown headline near the top.

must_haves.item: The coffee cup illustration and cream background are unchanged from the first output.
must_haves.why: The first output is not provided for comparison; the visible final image has a grey overlay covering most of the background and overlapping the cup.
The supplied image has equal width and height.
